REPUBLIC OF KENYA
IN THE CHIEF MAGISTRATE'S COURT AT BUNGOMA
CIVIL SUIT NO. 412 OF 2014
BETWEEN
PETER SIMIYU WEKESA ........ PLAINTIFF
AND
TUMAINI SACCO SOCIETY LIMITED ........ DEFENDANT
RULING
Coram: Hon. J. M. Nabwire-Opiyo, Senior Resident Magistrate
Delivered on 17th March 2015
1. The Defendant has raised a preliminary objection that this court lacks jurisdiction because the dispute, concerning the refund of the Plaintiff's deposits of KES 286,400, is a dispute between a co-operative society and a member.
2. Disputes of that nature fall within the exclusive jurisdiction of the Co-operative Tribunal, and the Plaintiff has not shown any reason why the Tribunal cannot determine it.
3. The preliminary objection is upheld and the suit is struck out with no order as to costs. The Plaintiff is at liberty to file his claim before the Co-operative Tribunal.
J. M. NABWIRE-OPIYO
SENIOR RESIDENT MAGISTRATE
